description: Fetch the full deposited DataCite metadata for one DOI: titles, creators and contributors with ORCID iDs and ROR affiliations, publisher, dates, version, subjects, descriptions, funding, geolocations, rights, sizes and formats, related identifiers with their relation types, related items (the journal or book it appears in, with volume, issue, pages, and its own creators), repository and provider, and citation, reference, version, part, view, and download counts. Long lists are capped with exact list/offset continuation recipes; select a list to retrieve later entries without losing the other metadata, or relation_types to page only the related identifiers of chosen relation types. sections returns only the named record groups, such as creators or fundingReferences, beside the identity fields, skipping long descriptions. datacite_trace_relations maps a bounded graph (at most 100 nodes and 1,000 edges). A DOI DataCite does not hold returns found: false naming the registration agency that does, or saying the DOI does not exist.

doi.description: The DOI, e.g. 10.5061/dryad.234: 10., a 4–9 digit registrant, a slash, and a suffix. Accepted bare, with doi: or info:doi/ prefixes, as a doi.org / dx.doi.org URL, or %2F-encoded; case-insensitive.

list.description: One capped list to page in deposit order; other record fields keep their default caps. relation_types selects relatedIdentifiers.

offset.description: Zero-based offset into valid mapped entries of list, after relation_types. Defaults to zero with list or relation_types; requires one of them.

relation_types.description: Page only the relatedIdentifiers entries asserting these relation types (IsCitedBy, IsDerivedFrom, HasPart, IsSupplementTo, …), any case, matched exactly against the record's own deposited types, in deposit order; offset and listPage then index the filtered entries. Selects list relatedIdentifiers; another list is rejected. relatedIdentifierCounts stays the whole record's. Values: datacite_list_reference topic relation_types.

sections.description: Return only these record groups, any case: creators, contributors, dates, subjects, descriptions, fundingReferences, geoLocations, rights, sizes, formats, alternateIdentifiers, relatedIdentifiers (with relatedIdentifierCounts), relatedItems. Titles, publisher, year, types, version, language, URLs, repository, counts, metadataLicense, and record timestamps always return; list and relation_types add their own group. Omit for the full record.

doi.description: The DOI, normalized to lowercase bare form.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `offset_without_list`: An offset is supplied without list or relation_types. `relation_types_other_list`: relation_types is supplied with list set to a list other than relatedIdentifiers. `invalid_doi`: The doi input is not a DOI after normalization. `rate_limited`: This deployment's shared DataCite request budget is spent: its request queue could not start a request before the call's deadline, or DataCite answered HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

formats.description: Formats as deposited. Found arm only.

found.description: True when DataCite holds a public record for the DOI.

fundingReferences.description: Funding, up to 100; full count in truncatedLists by default or listPage when selected. Found arm only.

funderIdentifierType.description: Scheme of funderIdentifier, e.g. ROR or Crossref Funder ID.

funderName.description: Plain-text funder name, with formatting tags removed and entities decoded once.

geoLocations.description: Geolocations, up to 50; full count in truncatedLists by default or listPage when selected. Found arm only.

polygon.description: Deposited polygon boundary and optional interior point.
